item.title: New Yorkers rally in solidarity with LGBTQ+ community after Trump ordered Stonewall Pride flag removed
item.description: By the time dusk settled over Christopher Park in New York City’s Greenwich Village neighborhood on Tuesday, the narrow triangle of green across from the Stonewall Inn had become a small, loud commons. Rainbow flags were draped over shoulders. Chants rose and fell between the park’s statues. item.title: Actor James Van Der Beek has died at age 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek has died following a diagnosis of colorectal cancer.
